page.description: Void Linux live ISOs: glibc and musl images, sizes and the project's sha256sum.txt.
page.intro: An independent distribution with its own package manager (xbps), runit as init, and a choice of glibc or musl. The live ISOs install from the same session.
pros: runit instead of systemd, with a simple service layout.
xbps is fast and the repositories are current (rolling).
glibc and musl variants from the same build.
The live ISO installs from the same session.
cons: Rolling updates are frequent and expected.
Smaller community and package set than the big distributions.
The image date is 2025-02-02; the repositories move on.
No screenshot with a reusable licence was confirmed, so the page is logo-only.
page.previewNote: No screenshot with a reusable licence was confirmed for Void Linux; the page shows the logo only. No image was written to a USB stick and nothing was booted.
page.status: One image per C library and desktop, written with dd or any image writer. Writing erases the stick; the installer then partitions or erases the target disk. The version is the image date (2025-02-02).
